scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,BRIDGE" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend" "node scripts/port-bridge.cjs"
scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build -w backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build -w frontend
scripts.start: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,BRIDGE" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start -w backend" "npm run start -w frontend" "node scripts/port-bridge.cjs"
